info.syllabusName: Phương pháp giảng dạy ngoại ngữ (Foreign Language Teaching Methodology)
info.description:
The course consists of 15 units and is divided into 2 parts:

Part 1: Unit 1- 8 present the principles of language learning and teaching; classroom management.

Part 2: Unit 9- 15 provide students with how to teach vocabulary, pronunciation, grammar, reading, listening, writing and speaking.
